title: Convergence of new reports 10 November 2026
excerpt: Final reports read DN-R01, DN-G01, DN-G02, RNG64-02/03/04 and RNG64-GPU-01, intermediate RESULTS/JOURNAL method RNG64-05, The search and the solvers were not re-started, the received experimental files were not changed.
html:
Final reports read DN-R01, DN-G01, DN-G02, RNG64-02/03/04 and RNG64-GPU-01, intermediate RESULTS/JOURNAL method RNG64-05, The search and the solvers were not re-started, the received experimental files were not changed.

New findings

Series Current status confirmed Boundary of withdrawal
DN-R01 → DN-G01 → DN-G02 Full range [0,2^31) posture 16 circuitry 2051 block 0 There's a separate final audit. Excluded specifics NextBytes/Next(256), endian, phase and stride Direct masking. Not all of it System.Random, not C# not all entropy→HD chains.
RNG64-02 31 A new local contradiction, 12 transferred old, 17 Uncompleted synthetic controls. 43/60 registered assemblies are excluded at this stage; 12 Transfers are not new independent exceptions.
RNG64-03 More 7 local contradictions; collectively 50/60, open-ended 10. Seven real real-life UNSAT They're rechecked by another solver. The rest of the actual inputs are not allowed due to incomplete blind synthetic recovery.
RNG64-04 New coordinate system: 20 try 10 In some cases, there is no complete recovery. The reduction of formulas showed no practical gain; open real hypotheses are not excluded.
RNG64-05 RUN_RESULT contains 10 synthetic_incomplete. Last one cvc5-try to SAT-Witness, but no proof of completeness. Journal reports artifact audit pending; FINAL_REPORT and COMPLETE They're not available at the time of reconciliation. These are calculated intermediate results, not a definitively accepted cycle.
RNG64-GPU-01 GPU-transference x upon y=z−x; Limited controls and benchmarks have been completed. Fully blind-recovery 64 No bits, no real inputs, no new exceptions.

What's checked in this reconciliation

check.py - an artifact of the initial study (check.py; outside the picture) checks SHA-256 seven certificate files, reads all of them separately SCAN.json full.NET-and checks the continuity, boundaries, tested, absence of candidates and errors ID assembly RNG64-02/03 giver 50 excluded and 10 open, no double counting GPU-The time is recalculated from the stored velocities. CHECKS.json - an artifact of the initial study (CHECKS.json; outside the picture.

It's a reconciliation of preserved artifacts, coatings and inference arithmetic. It's not a second complete GPU-passage, independent evidence UNSAT Or a full audit of the source code.

Significant reservations

  1. DN-G02 Completed: the phrase "complete search has not started" in the preparatory DN-R01/DN-G01 It's historically correct, but it doesn't describe the current outcome 16 schemas.NET It's now obsolete.
  2. DN-G02 Documents the restored recording failure STATUS. Coverage accepted is complete. CUDA-event and host-wall The timers diverge partially; the reason is not established. Speed should be quoted with this caveat, without mixing core and external duration.
  3. GPU: 33,6–44,5 billionth/c-short batch-measurements at synthetic inputs 2^64 with them 13,1–17,4 year one-off. With a record of everyone chunk measured 11,21 billion/c, extrapolation 52,1 It's different measurement modes, not a contradiction. Long-term steady speed has not been established.
  4. GPU Accelerates accurate verification of conditions PRNG; These candidates are not private Bitcoin-numeral secp256k1/HASH160. It is impossible to compare the indicator directly with the speed of the main address search.
  5. V RNG64-03 Five secondary blind checks are done retrospectively; the report reveals this. Basic checks have been cleared, follow-up checks completed. Two engines are no substitute for external validation of a formal certificate UNSAT.
  6. One SAT-witness RNG64-05 It's a synthetic key, and it doesn't prove that the real key is unique or restored GPU-The audit does not complete the entire audit RNG64-05.

What has changed for the following studies

  • Don't repeat DN-G02 and 50 closed-assemblies RNG64. Clarify the restrictions on exact patterns, not declare the entire family excluded.
  • For the ten open RNG64 We need a new technique to reduce/Resolving limitations or separately validated experiences with large limits. GPU-The port itself did not provide the practical cost of a complete search.
  • Former separate tracks MyWallet 2012 and product audits MultiBit/Hive These results are not closed.
  • Common README As of reading, it still describes RNG64-01 does not include new DN/RNG64 Summary, prepared review archive and copy Obsidian It is not automatically updated by this reconciliation.

Main reports

  • Total.NET-passageway DN-G02.
  • RNG64-02: assemblage.
  • RNG64-03: new-deciders.
  • RNG64-04: shifting.
  • RNG64-05: intermediates.
  • RNG64-GPU-01.

No new series reports a confirmed unknown bit of the present Puzzle-The key or practical shortening of the search for such a key.
